title: Freshness probing — Index Health Monitor
description:
The index health monitor watches the indexes the whole archive depends on and reports when one is failed, outdated, or incomplete — before users notice. It probes freshness against the source of truth, validates structural integrity, measures coverage, and raises graded alerts. An archive is only as trustworthy as its indexes; this tool is the trust instrument panel.

This record documents the freshness probing approach: Compare each index's newest entry timestamp against the source and flag lags past threshold.
